text:
Hi,

Arrived safely back in Australia and after a few hiccups have settled in well.

First of all I would like to commend Piero for her wonderful support given to me over the last few months. Her information and advice regarding the ultimate connection between thought and emotion has helped  me to understand the combined relation between the two. I am sure that by following her advice, and with the assistance of the psychiatrist we (as a team) can overcome the discomfort that I am currently going through.

Having a quaified counsellor listen and giving advice is so benrficial and I am confident that all in good time my issue (s) will be resolved.

I am probably back in Australia for 3 to 4 months for a medical procedure and in that time I will be seeking professional help here as well.

Regards!

Graham

Had my first Zoom session with a counsellor yesterday and wow, in only 90 minutes she gave me so much to think about, being a combination of new information & perspectives, and revisiting things I’ve not considered for years. Big thank you also to the support staff who've provided advice and helped organise my session. Looking forward to continuing.

I've been working with Brett for almost half a year now. Initially, I was nervous and uncertain whether I wanted to speak with someone but Brett made me feel very at ease and comfortable - which was important for me. He works with me in overall areas of my life such as; life coaching, personal development and career counselling. His experience, insight and knowledge has tremendously helped me tackle my issues head on and improve in areas I thought I wouldn't have been able to in such a short amount of time. There's still a lot of work to do but I'm looking forward to continuing my journey with Brett. I would definitely recommend him!

The Counselling Thailand team has been a great support to Panyaden International School, taking the time to speak to students, about the counselling profession, and about substance use and addiction. They are a great resource, and they care deeply about their work with young students. I look forward to welcoming them back year after year.

I highly recommend Counseling Thailand. Having searched for a therapist to help with my cross cultural relationship, I was very fortunate to be introduced to Doi, and the CT team.
The process from matching up with an ideal therapist, to the mechanics of our sessions, have been flawless.
My highest regard to Doi. His skillset is diverse, his ability to listen and share constructive feedback is excellent, and Doi’s ability to weave together language and cultural differences is impeccable.
If you are looking to do personal growth work, Doi and CT are partners worth exploring.

Pleasant, affable and comminucative, Brett is a breath of fresh air in an industry where it can be hard to find a good fit in a counsellor. Brett offers flexible time slots, great advice and a multifaceted approach to sessions employing various counselling skills and techniques. I have known and worked with Brett now since 2018 and have always had complete faith in his approach and dedication to me as a client and would highly recommend him to anyone. What really makes Brett stand out from the crowd is that it's easy to tell that he really cares. That makes the world of difference.

I recently sought counselling services at Counselling Thailand I couldn't be more impressed with the experience. From the moment I walked in, the atmosphere was welcoming and calming. My counsellor Doi was warm, welcoming instantly putting me at ease.
What stood out the most was the depth of knowledge and expertise. Doi listened attentively to my concerns and provided insightful guidance tailored to my specific needs. I felt understood and supported throughout the sessions, which greatly contributed to my progress.
I highly recommend Counselling Thailand to anyone seeking quality counselling services. Their compassionate approach, combined with their professionalism and expertise, truly makes a difference in people's lives.

I have know Brett a very long time and have been accessing his services for some time.
Recently I’ve been working on my overeating and lacking confidence and must say that although I was unsure if the hypnosis would work, I am seeing great results.
Brett is so easy to talk too and is very genuine and caring.
Since focusing on my main problems I feel am becoming more confident and have continuously lost weight.
I was very unsure on whether it would “work” for me but have found the more sessions I do the deeper my hypnosis is becoming.
Brett is a reliable and good hypnotherapist and has excellent communication skills. He has the ability to make me feel at ease and relaxed right from the start. I do feel I could tell him anything without judgement. I cannot recommend him enough and would urge anyone who is unsure to give him a go.
Thank you so much Brett. 😁

I have known Brett for 2 years and previously worked with him as my therapist. He is one of the most genuine, caring, committed and supportive counsellors I have ever come across and has been a huge ongoing support to me since then and has helped me through some very difficult times in my life. He has the experience of going through some of the exact things that I have had to deal with and his first hand experience made him extremely understanding and non-judgemental about anything that I would bring to him. I am extremely grateful to know him.

Brett is one of the best therapists I've ever had (and believe me I've had my fair share over the years) I just love his down to earth and non judgemental approach. I've seen so many improvements in myself since I started having therapy sessions with Brett. He not only makes me feel like I can talk about anything, but he also gives a lot of support and guidance in between sessions which I've found so helpful. I'm extremely grateful to have found him when I did!

The best online counsellor in Thailand!!

I met Brett whilst working in the addiction treatment field over in Thailand and I am grateful for the knowledge and experience he was able to give me whilst I was struggling over there. I myself have had one on one sessions with him whilst in Thailand in person and have maintained a connection with him via his online counsellor Thailand forum as I have moved back to Indonesia. the benefits I've received from actually working with him professionally have been huge for me and for my family. his years of  experience in the field have enabled him to have a really deep understanding of how the addiction and recovery way of life works and his knowledge has been invaluable for me. I'm able to rely on him when I have been struggling with my own personal issues and issues that I've had with the work that I've been doing. my family back home are so very grateful for the continued support I receive from him as they understand how  much he has helped me and in turn impacted my life for the better. if anyone is struggling with substance abuse issues or anxiety or depression or other types of mental illness Brett is your man. His approach is professional, compassionate and friendly and the peace i have in my life today is a direct result of taking his advice and suggestions. Thank you so much Brett you've pulled me out of a mental hole on numerous occasions and I am forever grateful

The team truly listens and supports you every step of the way. Their care and guidance helped me move through a tough time and find clarity. I’m really grateful and would highly recommend them to anyone seeking real, compassionate support.

I have been seeing a psychotherapist that I found on the Counselling Thailand website for 9 months now, and my only gripe is that I didn't do it sooner! Counselling Thailand has made it very easy to find the right fit for me, and their communication is always clear and consistent. I have a much better understanding of my thoughts and behaviour then when I did prior to starting therapy. I also have the tools required to be a better version of myself, and I look forward to speaking with my therapist twice a month. Therapy should be accessible to everyone; because we all need someone to talk to without judgement, and we all sometimes need to hear our thoughts outside of our own heads in order to better understand ourselves, and I genuinely feel that Counselling Thailand made therapy more accessible to me more than any other company that I've tried in the past. I most definitely recommend using their services if you are looking to find someone to speak to, no matter what your challenge.

Brett is a very honest, kind and caring individual. I have had the pleasure of knowing him for over 20 years now and I’ve seen how friends have benefited from working with him. He has a wide berth of experience and his approach is one of genuine concern and he applies his experience to help the individuals in need. His guidance and support has helped me through traumatic times which life can often throw at us. I would always recommend Brett for his counselling and hypnotherapy skills.

Counseling Thailand has connected me with the very best counselor for me. I am an American and she is Thai. But we have many many elements in common. For example we both suffered from same type cancer and she had to adjust to another country’s culture at one point in her life. There are more but for sake of brevity that is a good example. Her ideas for different perspectives on my situations are incredibly insightful and inspiring. She is the best

Have known Brett for 5 years now and has helped me tremendously in my journey. Brett was actually there from the very beginning of my new life. Brett and I have still kept in contact and still do today always checking up on how I am doing etc. I have benefitted so much from his work and so has my family. Forever grateful for him and recommend him highly as a counsellor/ therapist. Thanks Brett! From the Milk Monster

Brett is a great life coach. I have a hard time making a decision during a sudden life changes. With just a few sessions, I am able to make a decision that I am confident with. There are a lot of thinking process that I need to go through …

I have my share of problems like anyone else but always preferred to deal with them on my own. Tried a few counsellors but never managed to connect well. Then I met Brett who effortlessly won my trust, and went on to help me tear down a number of walls I had created (and still does). The magic happened because he chose to first understand me as an individual, as opposed to offering me pre-programmed text book solutions. He shows you that he cares about your problems, and offers you a variety of approaches to deal with them. He has a keen eye for detail and a calm and pleasant attitude towards life. A highly knowledgeable and reliable individual, I recommend Brett for sure.

Life-Changing. The staff and counsellors here really care and have a true passion for helping others. They go above and beyond to provide personalized support and guidance. Thanks to their unwavering support, I've been able to overcome obstacles and embrace positive change in my life. I can't recommend them highly enough to anyone seeking compassionate and effective counselling services.

I used Counselling in Thailand for 6 months while my family was experiencing some health struggles. It was a wonderful experience and helped me immensely during a difficult time. I would highly recommend their services if you are interested in seeking therapy.

I have worked with Bretts program over the last 6 months and it has helped me sort through several issues I was finding it very difficult to deal with.
I found Brett very quickly and skillfully put me at ease with talking to him and I was able to relate very well with his experience and knowledge.  I actually enjoyed the work he set me and the guidance he showed was very valuable to me. I have no problem in recommending his service.

Brett is an extremely empathetic and personable counsellor. It has been a pleasure to work closely with him and observe his ability to connect with clients of all ages and from all walks of life. His non-judgemental approach enables him to counsel couples and families, as well as individual clients. With his extensive experience and knowledge he is able to support anyone with motivation to change. Highly recommended.

I have known Brett professionally and personally for over 8 years. We used to work together at the Cabin rehab Chiangmai and since starting his own private counseling practice 3 years ago he has continued to help many more people. I would highly recommend him as a counselor.

Brett has helped many people I know in Chiang Mai. As well as being a great listener he has a way of putting people at ease & enabling them to open up. He is very understanding & easy to talk with & has helped people make breakthroughs that they perhaps wouldn't have from other approaches.

Highly recommended

Starting counselling was one of the best decisions I've ever made. My therapist Prieo was compassionate, knowledgeable, and dedicated to helping me achieve my goals. They empowered me to make positive changes in my life, and I couldn't be happier with the results. Highly recommended !

While I have only known Brett professionally for a short time, I have been fortunate to observe some of his counseling activities.  I was impressed by Bret's passion for helping clients, as well as his skills and abilities to help clients move forward in their growth vis-a-vis their psychological and emotional well-being.

Counselling Thailand takes a holistic approach to counselling, addressing not just the symptoms but also the underlying causes of emotional distress. Their comprehensive approach has helped me develop a greater sense of self-awareness and empowered me to make many positive changes in my life. I wholeheartedly endorse this company for anyone seeking holistic and effective counselling services.

Five stars isn’t enough for this review. I went to rehab in Thiland where Brett was my 1 on 1 counsellor. Together he made me find me. We turned rocks upside down and cleared all the skeletons out the closets. Brett was always so lovely and patient with me. He identified and made you feel at ease. I never felt Brett was judging only listening and supporting me throughout my stay. Brett you saved my life and so many others. Greatful is an understatement. Thank you for saving my life. I generally couldn’t of done this without you. Ps sorry this is like 2 year late. Rob xxxx

I have been involved in therapy and counseling for most of my adult life. I am 49, and have had challenges with chemical dependency, depression, anxiety and some basic and devastating life problems as well. With all the PHD, PsyD and CSAC's (certified substance abuse counselor's) and likewise accredited behavioral health professionals, though the years, I have found that Brett to be the most effective and well rounded thus far. He has great knowledge and insight, is sincere, and cares. Brett  far surpasses my expectations and is one of the best I have had the fortunate experience of crossing paths with finally.  I am currently and have been, for quite some time now, working with Brett 2x a week, and have found that his depth and perspective to be very enlightening, motivating, and helpful. I need the help! I often do not look forward to working with a therapist, as I have had so many. However,  now I like too, and want to with Brett. I am now understanding not only my issues, but how to better manage them, while MOVING FORWARD at the same time. Many therapists are too academic, some are too 12-step based and some have had no real-life experience with the subject matter at hand. Brett knows all sides, which for me keeps it objective, realistic, and balanced. Some therapists just ask open ended questions and are too agreeable. Brett is able to offer up different viewpoints, often to the point where I can learn, as opposed to someone who just agrees with me all the time is often just not helping me, in my experience. This becomes a waste of time and resources and I do not get better or begin to change/heal. He offers suggestions regarding short and long term strategies, whilst offering up specific tactics (actual means) on how to achieve those goals, too. I need the tactics, more so than just the strategy (just an objective/aim). Thanks Brett for your continued support, and I finally feel I am making some ground up on how to live life, live life clean and sober, with purpose and more HOPE. Thus far, I am in far better place than I have been in many many years.  All the best!

JS

I'm so grateful that I found Brett. He's helped me so much in just a short period of time. I enjoy his proactive approach -  the tasks and actionable steps that he gives me are really helpful. I'd highly recommend him to anyone looking to make positive changes in their life. Thank you Brett.
My Thai girlfriend and I were going through some really tough times, unable to communicate effectively, fighting, hurting each other until we discovered CounsellingThailand. …

I have only known Brett a short time i find him to be very genuine and caring councellor. He has a very clever way of explaining things to you in a way that is easy to understand. I also find him easy going and feel comfortable talking to him about anything. I would highly recommend Brett for counseling and hypnotherapy.

I previously with Brett as my counselor in Chiang Mai and found him to be kind, genuine, understanding, trustworthy, nonjudgemental, compassionate, and extremely knowledgeable in how he combined counseling, hypnotherapy and life coaching to help guide me in the right direction. Very grateful for all the help and support and highly recommend to anyone looking for therapy or counseling in Chiang Mai.

Boat was a true professional and an incredible source of support. He  had a deep understanding of my struggles and provided me with personalised guidance and tools to overcome them. I felt heard and understood throughout the entire process. Highly recommended

Brett (Yim Thai) worked with my 12-year-old daughter on an OCD issue and was wonderful with her -- kind, gentle, funny and highly professional. She's made good progress and will visit him again soon. Yim Thai is an impressive fellow with a light touch and deep commitment to his work.

Brett offers a range of alternative therapy options in Chiang Mai including counselling, hypnotherapy and life coaching. Brett's Past, Present, Future Therapy model is really effective to motivate others towards change and yield positive results. I would highly recommend Chiang Mai Counseling and Counselling Thailand to anyone looking to work with a professional and experienced therapist who thinks outside the box. Many Thanks

Looking for a therapist in Chiang Mai i came across Brett at Yim Thai and i am so glad i did. Brett has been very helpful getting me through some difficult times with his knowledge and experience of what i am dealing with. A big plus for me is reliability which can be hard to come by these days.  Forever grateful  for finding Yim Thai

Brett has the uncanny knack of turning his intelect into empathy. He listens without prejudice and can see the bigger picture when I was only thinking about my immediate problems.
He has the ability to make you feel relaxed and therefore open to discussion about the real issues. Not too serious either: we can have a laugh about almost anything which is an important element of the healing process.
Thanks again
Mick

Most therapists only offer 45-50 minute sessions which in my opinion is not long enough. I think Brett's recommendations for 90 minute sessions is an excellent idea as it allows sufficient time to process without feeling rushed and really …

I have been working with Brett for more than 1 year and it's been an amazing experience!
What started as a counseling and hypnotherapy work, ended up in a lifelong friendship!
I totally reccomend him!
Gracias Brett

Brett knows his stuff. No nonsense, yet genuinely caring and insightful. He offers a wealth of experience and passes this on for a very reasonable fee, without bravado. Brett is a wonderful person to have in your corner.
I have known Brett professionally for 5 years. In that time he has always been a pleasure to deal with. He has helped many people and I would happily refer any clients to him.

We were confused about the time of our first appointment and mistook the 17:00 time slot for 7pm. We were surprised that they just took the entire amount for the interview and wouldn't reschedule us without full payment again. I understand …
I had the privilege of having Brett as my counsellor who’s helped me a lot on my journey. His way with people and ability to connect is great. Would highly recommend.

Professional and knowledgeable in a variety of different counseling techniques. Helped me through a lot of difficulty and was empathetic and caring throughout our sessions. Would highly recommend Brett to anyone looking for counseling services.
Brett has helped me in so many ways, he’s honest and very reliable with a wealth of experience. I Definitely recommend this wonderful man. Thank you for all you have done for me.

In the short time I knew Brett he did everything he could to help. He was literally the most genuine person and I can only reiterate that he helped me from being on the floor to transforming my outlook on life today. Thanks again Brett

"I can't thank my CT enough for their exceptional guidance and support. They helped me navigate through a difficult phase in my life and provided me with invaluable advice and techniques. Their compassionate and non-judgmental approach made all the difference. I highly recommend their counseling services!"
Really helpful. Lovely staff and great info. Gave me what I needed and asked for in a tough time. 100%
Brett worked with me in 2014. He was always very friendly and professional. He always received very positive feedback from his clients.
Best therapy experience in my life, period.
We've been lucky to work with the CT team at a recent conference. They're professional, accommodating, and a powerful addition to any event.
Jip has been incredible.  She has become an integral part in recovery through a very tough challenge.  Highly highly recommend.

For anyone looking for counseling services, I highly recommend this place. The environment is great and very friendly, making it comfortable to share my thoughts and feelings. My counselor, Priew, listened attentively and offered helpful advice that significantly helped me overcome obstacles and improve myself. I would like to thank Priew for all her support.

The consulting service I received exceeded my expectations. Jenny was highly skilled and professional, helping me navigate a challenging period in my life and fostering a deeper understanding of myself and my relationships. I am deeply grateful for this service and would highly recommend it.
"Prim provided excellent advice and created a safe environment, helping me manage my emotions and difficult situations. I am truly grateful for this experience."

It was a wonderful experience for me. They created a safe, non-judgmental space where I felt comfortable opening up about all my issues. Their guidance and expert advice helped me gain clarity and make positive changes in my life. I am so grateful for their support!

Thank you, Priew, for our session. Thank you for listening attentively and caring about everything we explained, asking insightful questions, and offering practical strategies to overcome our challenges. With the therapist's expertise and care, I highly recommend the consultation services here.
